items.headline: Turner Helton, Tripp Bryant lead Georgia Southern to 23-15 victory over Old Dominion
items.description: — Turner Helton threw a touchdown pass and Tripp Bryant kicked three field goals to guide Georgia Southern to a 23-15 victory over Old Dominion on Thursday night.

items.headline: Devin Roche, Maurki James help Old Dominion upset Appalachian State 10-3
items.description: — Devin Roche rushed for 101 yards, and Maurki James scored the game’s only touchdown as Old Dominion beat Appalachian State 10-3 on Saturday.
